description: This file contains a set of shell script tests for Git commit authorship options, including testing various flags like -C, -c, --amend, --reset-author, and their behaviors under different circumstances. It also defines helper functions for extracting author headers and commit messages.

methods.name: author_header
methods.description: Extracts the author line from a given commit hash.

methods.name: message_body
methods.description: Extracts the commit message body from a given commit hash.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Constructs a file path within the Git objects directory based on a SHA-1 string.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Deletes a Git object file based on a SHA-1 string.
